name: Discovering your purpose and calling
promise: Six days on why you were made and how to walk in it.
why: For anyone asking what their life is for. The path defines a call from God, roots purpose in Christ the Maker, helps you take inventory of the grace on your life, shows what a call carries, and asks for faithfulness in small things and steadiness in your assignment.

days.theme: What a call from God is
days.key_quote: It's not your ability that is your meaning; it's your assignment that is your meaning.

days.theme: Purpose is found in the Maker
days.key_quote: It is not the product that tells the manufacturer what it was manufactured for.
When you locate the fact that there is grace in a certain area, you need to labor to sharpen it.

days.theme: A call has an objective and place
days.key_quote: God will not do anything on the earth without a calling.

days.theme: Be faithful in the little things
days.key_quote: If you are too big to do little things, you'll be too little to do big things.
You will pass through many seasons in the implementation of that assignment, but the assignment itself does not change.
